failure_causes_found: Collinear struts that meet end to end: coaxial end faces coincide, kernel rejects. Fixed by one long cylinder per line (lines mode).
Three or more struts through one point: triple-point degeneracy. Fixed by a per-line offset of 0.01 mm in the normal plane.
Sphere radius equal to strut radius: tangent contact. Fixed with 1.002 r.
Sphere pole aligned with a strut axis: the fuse returned an empty solid. Fixed by rotating the sphere.
open_issues: BCC/FCC/FBCC/BCCZ at 20 mm fail or are unverified; the kernel boolean is not robust at this strut count.
Kelvin and FCC fail at 8 mm.
